title_en: Duplex with courtyard in Swan Lake Residence!
description_en: Duplex with courtyard for sale in Swan Lake Residence. The duplex has a surface area of ​​155.98 m2, of which 101.9 m2 is internal surface, 50 m2 is veranda surface, and 14.08 m2 is common surface. The duplex also has a yard with an area of ​​135.5 m2 and parking space for 2 cars. The 1st floor is organized into a living room with a kitchen and dining area and 1 toilet. Floor 0 is organized in 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom and veranda. Swan Lake Residence is a new residence with villas and apartments, which has a perfect location by the lake of Farka and the pedestrian promenade, overlooking Dajti mountain and with a fantastic view at any moment of the day. Positioned in the middle of greenery and fresh air, it makes the place ideal for living in privacy, tranquility, in harmony with nature and very close to the city. For a visit to the property, you are welcome to contact us!
